question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE courses AS
SELECT
  sos.term_code AS term_code,
  sos.subject_id AS subject_id,
  sos.subject_title AS subject_title,
  sos.total_units AS total_units,
  sos.course_number AS course_number,
  -- Derive subject_code and subject_number from subject_id when possible
  SPLIT_PART(sos.subject_id, '.', 1) AS subject_code,
  SPLIT_PART(sos.subject_id, '.', 2) AS subject_number,
  sos.offer_dept_name AS offer_dept_name
FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary AS sos

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE meetings AS
SELECT
  s.term_code AS term_code,
  s.subject_id AS subject_id,
  s.meet_place AS meet_place,
  s.meet_start_time AS meet_start_time,
  s.meet_end_time AS meet_end_time
FROM beaver.subject_iap_schedule AS s

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rooms AS
SELECT
  r.building_room AS building_room,
  r.room AS room,
  r.area AS area,
  r.organization_name AS organization_name,
  r.major_use_desc AS major_use_desc,
  r.use_desc AS use_desc,
  r.minor_use_desc AS minor_use_desc,
  r.fclt_building_key AS fclt_building_key
FROM beaver.fclt_rooms AS r

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE buildings AS
WITH addr AS (
  SELECT fclt_building_key, city, state
  FROM beaver.fclt_building_address
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fclt_building_key ORDER BY warehouse_load_date DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  b.fclt_building_key AS fclt_building_key,
  b.building_number AS building_number,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name_long,
  a.city AS city,
  a.state AS state
FROM beaver.fclt_building AS b
LEFT JOIN addr AS a
  ON a.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "courses" AS SELECT
  sos.term_code AS term_code,
  sos.subject_id AS subject_id,
  sos.subject_title AS subject_title,
  sos.total_units AS total_units,
  sos.course_number AS course_number,
  split_part(sos.subject_id, '.', 1) AS subject_code,
  split_part(sos.subject_id, '.', 2) AS subject_number,
  sos.offer_dept_name AS offer_dept_name
FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary AS sos

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "meetings" AS SELECT
  s.term_code AS term_code,
  s.subject_id AS subject_id,
  s.meet_place AS meet_place,
  s.meet_start_time AS meet_start_time,
  s.meet_end_time AS meet_end_time
FROM beaver.subject_iap_schedule AS s

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms" AS SELECT
  r.building_room AS building_room,
  r.room AS room,
  r.area AS area,
  r.organization_name AS organization_name,
  r.major_use_desc AS major_use_desc,
  r.use_desc AS use_desc,
  r.minor_use_desc AS minor_use_desc,
  r.fclt_building_key AS fclt_building_key
FROM beaver.fclt_rooms AS r

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS WITH addr_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.fclt_building_key,
    a.city,
    a.state,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.fclt_building_key ORDER BY a.warehouse_load_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM beaver.fclt_building_address AS a
)
SELECT
  b.fclt_building_key AS fclt_building_key,
  b.building_number AS building_number,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name_long,
  ar.city AS city,
  ar.state AS state
FROM beaver.fclt_building AS b
LEFT JOIN addr_ranked AS ar
  ON ar.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key AND ar.rn = 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "courses" AS WITH cols AS (
  SELECT 'term_code,subject_id,subject_title,total_units,course_number,subject_code,subject_number,offer_dept_name' AS columns
)
SELECT c.*, cols.columns
FROM courses AS c, cols

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "meetings" AS WITH cols AS (
  SELECT 'term_code,subject_id,meet_place,meet_start_time,meet_end_time' AS columns
)
SELECT m.*, cols.columns
FROM meetings AS m, cols

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms" AS WITH cols AS (
  SELECT 'building_room,room,area,organization_name,major_use_desc,use_desc,minor_use_desc,fclt_building_key' AS columns
)
SELECT r.*, cols.columns
FROM rooms AS r, cols

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS WITH cols AS (
  SELECT 'fclt_building_key,building_number,building_name_long,city,state' AS columns
)
SELECT b.*, cols.columns
FROM buildings AS b, cols

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH mtg AS (
    SELECT term_code, subject_id, meet_place, meet_start_time, meet_end_time
    FROM meetings
    WHERE meet_place IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_place) <> ''
      AND meet_start_time IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_start_time) <> ''
      AND meet_end_time IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_end_time) <> ''
),
meet_norm AS (
    -- Attempt to normalize meet_place to building-room like '26-100'
    SELECT term_code, subject_id, meet_place,
           meet_start_time, meet_end_time,
           UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(meet_place, ' ', ''), '	', '')) AS meet_place_norm
    FROM mtg
),
-- Link meetings to rooms by matching normalized meet_place to building_room
mtg_room AS (
    SELECT m.term_code, m.subject_id, m.meet_place, m.meet_start_time, m.meet_end_time,
           r.building_room, r.room, r.area, r.organization_name, r.major_use_desc, r.use_desc, r.minor_use_desc, r.fclt_building_key
    FROM meet_norm m
    JOIN rooms r
      ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room, ' ', '')) = m.meet_place_norm
),
-- Buildings with name and city/state
bld AS (
    SELECT b.fclt_building_key, b.building_number, b.building_name_long, a.city, a.state
    FROM buildings b
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT fclt_building_key, ANY_VALUE(city) AS city, ANY_VALUE(state) AS state
        FROM buildings
        GROUP BY fclt_building_key
    ) a USING (fclt_building_key)
),
crs AS (
    SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, total_units, course_number, subject_code, subject_number, offer_dept_name
    FROM courses
)
SELECT 
  c.term_code,
  c.subject_id,
  c.subject_title,
  c.course_number,
  c.subject_code,
  c.subject_number,
  c.offer_dept_name,
  COALESCE(CAST(c.total_units AS DOUBLE), NULL) AS total_units,
  mr.room AS room_number,
  mr.building_room,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name,
  b.building_number,
  b.city AS building_city,
  b.state AS building_state,
  mr.area,
  mr.organization_name,
  mr.major_use_desc AS room_usage_major,
  mr.use_desc AS room_usage_use,
  mr.minor_use_desc AS room_usage_minor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(mr.meet_start_time, '-', mr.meet_end_time)) AS unique_meeting_times,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.subject_id) AS total_subjects
FROM crs c
JOIN mtg_room mr
  ON c.term_code = mr.term_code AND c.subject_id = mr.subject_id
LEFT JOIN bld b
  ON mr.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
GROUP BY 
  c.term_code, c.subject_id, c.subject_title, c.course_number, c.subject_code, c.subject_number, c.offer_dept_name, total_units,
  mr.room, mr.building_room, b.building_name_long, b.building_number, b.city, b.state, mr.area, mr.organization_name, mr.major_use_desc, mr.use_desc, mr.minor_use_desc
ORDER BY c.term_code, c.subject_id
LIMIT 200

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH mtg AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, meet_place, meet_start_time, meet_end_time
  FROM meetings
  WHERE meet_place IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_place) <> ''
    AND meet_start_time IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_start_time) <> ''
    AND meet_end_time IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_end_time) <> ''
    AND UPPER(meet_place) NOT LIKE '%ONLINE%'
    AND UPPER(meet_place) NOT LIKE '%ZOOM%'
),
-- Normalize meet_place; also attempt to extract room token after any commas or slashes
meet_tokens AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    subject_id,
    meet_place,
    meet_start_time,
    meet_end_time,
    UPPER(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(meet_place, '[	 ]+', '', 'g'), '—', '-')) AS place_nospace,
    UPPER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(meet_place, ',', 1))) AS place_first
  FROM mtg
),
-- Candidate keys to match: full building-room, or ROOM_NUMBER from space_detail
space AS (
  SELECT 
    s.building_key,
    s.building_room,
    s.room_number,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS building_number,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS city,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS state
  FROM rooms r
  RIGHT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT building_key, building_room, room_number FROM space_detail
  ) s
  ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(s.building_room,' ',''))
),
-- Primary room match by exact building_room token
mtg_room1 AS (
  SELECT m.term_code, m.subject_id, m.meet_place, m.meet_start_time, m.meet_end_time,
         r.building_room, r.room, r.area, r.organization_name, r.major_use_desc, r.use_desc, r.minor_use_desc, r.fclt_building_key
  FROM meet_tokens m
  JOIN rooms r
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(m.place_first,' ',''))
),
-- Secondary match: meet_place equals space_detail.building_room
mtg_room2 AS (
  SELECT m.term_code, m.subject_id, m.meet_place, m.meet_start_time, m.meet_end_time,
         r.building_room, r.room, r.area, r.organization_name, r.major_use_desc, r.use_desc, r.minor_use_desc, r.fclt_building_key
  FROM meet_tokens m
  JOIN rooms r
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(m.place_nospace,' ',''))
),
-- Tertiary match: if meet_place is just a room number and uniquely identifies a space_detail row, map via space_detail -> rooms by building_room
roomnum_candidates AS (
  SELECT sd.room_number, sd.building_room
  FROM (
    SELECT room_number, COUNT(DISTINCT building_room) AS cnt
    FROM space_detail
    WHERE room_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(room_number) <> ''
    GROUP BY room_number
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT building_room) = 1
  ) u
  JOIN space_detail sd ON sd.room_number = u.room_number
),
mtg_room3 AS (
  SELECT m.term_code, m.subject_id, m.meet_place, m.meet_start_time, m.meet_end_time,
         r.building_room, r.room, r.area, r.organization_name, r.major_use_desc, r.use_desc, r.minor_use_desc, r.fclt_building_key
  FROM meet_tokens m
  JOIN roomnum_candidates rc
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(m.place_first,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(rc.room_number,' ',''))
  JOIN rooms r
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(rc.building_room,' ',''))
),
mtg_room AS (
  SELECT * FROM mtg_room1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM mtg_room2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM mtg_room3
),
-- Buildings (use buildings table directly; if city/state missing there, enrich from fclt_building_address)
bld_base AS (
  SELECT b.fclt_building_key, b.building_number, b.building_name_long, b.city, b.state
  FROM buildings b
),
bld_enriched AS (
  SELECT bb.fclt_building_key,
         COALESCE(bb.building_number, fba.building_number) AS building_number,
         bb.building_name_long,
         COALESCE(bb.city, fba.city) AS city,
         COALESCE(bb.state, fba.state) AS state
  FROM bld_base bb
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT fclt_building_key, ANY_VALUE(building_number) AS building_number, ANY_VALUE(city) AS city, ANY_VALUE(state) AS state
    FROM fclt_building_address
    GROUP BY fclt_building_key
  ) fba USING (fclt_building_key)
),
crs AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, total_units, course_number, subject_code, subject_number, offer_dept_name
  FROM courses
)
SELECT 
  c.term_code,
  c.subject_id,
  c.subject_title,
  c.course_number,
  c.subject_code,
  c.subject_number,
  c.offer_dept_name,
  CAST(c.total_units AS DOUBLE) AS total_units,
  mr.room AS room_number,
  mr.building_room,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name,
  b.building_number,
  b.city AS building_city,
  b.state AS building_state,
  mr.area,
  mr.organization_name,
  mr.major_use_desc AS room_usage_major,
  mr.use_desc AS room_usage_use,
  mr.minor_use_desc AS room_usage_minor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(mr.meet_start_time,'-',mr.meet_end_time)) AS unique_meeting_times,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.subject_id) AS total_subjects
FROM crs c
JOIN mtg_room mr
  ON c.term_code = mr.term_code AND c.subject_id = mr.subject_id
LEFT JOIN bld_enriched b
  ON mr.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
GROUP BY 
  c.term_code, c.subject_id, c.subject_title, c.course_number, c.subject_code, c.subject_number, c.offer_dept_name, total_units,
  mr.room, mr.building_room, b.building_name_long, b.building_number, b.city, b.state, mr.area, mr.organization_name, mr.major_use_desc, mr.use_desc, mr.minor_use_desc
ORDER BY c.term_code, c.subject_id
LIMIT 200

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH mtg AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, meet_place, meet_start_time, meet_end_time
  FROM meetings
  WHERE meet_place IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_place) <> ''
    AND meet_start_time IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_start_time) <> ''
    AND meet_end_time IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_end_time) <> ''
    AND UPPER(meet_place) NOT LIKE '%ONLINE%'
    AND UPPER(meet_place) NOT LIKE '%ZOOM%'
),
meet_tokens AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    subject_id,
    meet_place,
    meet_start_time,
    meet_end_time,
    UPPER(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(meet_place, '[	 ]+', '', 'g'), '—', '-')) AS place_nospace,
    UPPER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(meet_place, ',', 1))) AS place_first
  FROM mtg
),
-- Use beaver.space_detail to help map room numbers to building_room when unique
roomnum_candidates AS (
  SELECT sd.room_number, sd.building_room
  FROM (
    SELECT room_number, COUNT(DISTINCT building_room) AS cnt
    FROM beaver.space_detail
    WHERE room_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(room_number) <> ''
    GROUP BY room_number
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT building_room) = 1
  ) u
  JOIN beaver.space_detail sd ON sd.room_number = u.room_number
),
-- Primary room match by exact building_room token (first token)
mtg_room1 AS (
  SELECT m.term_code, m.subject_id, m.meet_place, m.meet_start_time, m.meet_end_time,
         r.building_room, r.room, r.area, r.organization_name, r.major_use_desc, r.use_desc, r.minor_use_desc, r.fclt_building_key
  FROM meet_tokens m
  JOIN rooms r
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(m.place_first,' ',''))
),
-- Secondary match: meeting place without spaces equals building_room
mtg_room2 AS (
  SELECT m.term_code, m.subject_id, m.meet_place, m.meet_start_time, m.meet_end_time,
         r.building_room, r.room, r.area, r.organization_name, r.major_use_desc, r.use_desc, r.minor_use_desc, r.fclt_building_key
  FROM meet_tokens m
  JOIN rooms r
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(m.place_nospace,' ',''))
),
-- Tertiary match via unique room number -> building_room
mtg_room3 AS (
  SELECT m.term_code, m.subject_id, m.meet_place, m.meet_start_time, m.meet_end_time,
         r.building_room, r.room, r.area, r.organization_name, r.major_use_desc, r.use_desc, r.minor_use_desc, r.fclt_building_key
  FROM meet_tokens m
  JOIN roomnum_candidates rc
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(m.place_first,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(rc.room_number,' ',''))
  JOIN rooms r
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(rc.building_room,' ',''))
),
mtg_room AS (
  SELECT * FROM mtg_room1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM mtg_room2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM mtg_room3
),
-- Enrich building info; fall back to beaver.fclt_building_address if needed
bld_enriched AS (
  SELECT b.fclt_building_key,
         b.building_number,
         b.building_name_long,
         COALESCE(b.city, fba.city) AS city,
         COALESCE(b.state, fba.state) AS state
  FROM buildings b
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT fclt_building_key, ANY_VALUE(city) AS city, ANY_VALUE(state) AS state
    FROM beaver.fclt_building_address
    GROUP BY fclt_building_key
  ) fba USING (fclt_building_key)
),
crs AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, total_units, course_number, subject_code, subject_number, offer_dept_name
  FROM courses
)
SELECT 
  c.term_code,
  c.subject_id,
  c.subject_title,
  c.course_number,
  c.subject_code,
  c.subject_number,
  c.offer_dept_name,
  CAST(c.total_units AS DOUBLE) AS total_units,
  mr.room AS room_number,
  mr.building_room,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name,
  b.building_number,
  b.city AS building_city,
  b.state AS building_state,
  mr.area,
  mr.organization_name,
  mr.major_use_desc AS room_usage_major,
  mr.use_desc AS room_usage_use,
  mr.minor_use_desc AS room_usage_minor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(mr.meet_start_time,'-',mr.meet_end_time)) AS unique_meeting_times,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.subject_id) AS total_subjects
FROM crs c
JOIN mtg_room mr
  ON c.term_code = mr.term_code AND c.subject_id = mr.subject_id
LEFT JOIN bld_enriched b
  ON mr.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
GROUP BY 
  c.term_code, c.subject_id, c.subject_title, c.course_number, c.subject_code, c.subject_number, c.offer_dept_name, total_units,
  mr.room, mr.building_room, b.building_name_long, b.building_number, b.city, b.state, mr.area, mr.organization_name, mr.major_use_desc, mr.use_desc, mr.minor_use_desc
ORDER BY c.term_code, c.subject_id
LIMIT 200

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH crs AS (
  SELECT 
    term_code,
    subject_id,
    subject_title,
    CAST(total_units AS DOUBLE) AS total_units,
    course_number,
    subject_code,
    subject_number,
    offer_dept_name
  FROM courses
),
-- Derive building_room from subject_id when it appears as suffix like 'HAA.5536' (won't match) or embedded 'E15-460' in title; try from title and course_number too
loc_tokens AS (
  SELECT 
    c.term_code,
    c.subject_id,
    c.subject_title,
    c.total_units,
    c.course_number,
    c.subject_code,
    c.subject_number,
    c.offer_dept_name,
    -- search for patterns like 'E15-460', '26-100', '1-190'
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(c.subject_title), '([A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+)') AS br_from_title,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(c.course_number), '([A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+)') AS br_from_course
  FROM crs c
),
loc AS (
  SELECT *, COALESCE(br_from_title, br_from_course) AS building_room_guess
  FROM loc_tokens
  WHERE COALESCE(br_from_title, br_from_course) IS NOT NULL
),
room_match AS (
  SELECT 
    l.term_code,
    l.subject_id,
    l.subject_title,
    l.total_units,
    l.course_number,
    l.subject_code,
    l.subject_number,
    l.offer_dept_name,
    r.room,
    r.building_room,
    r.fclt_building_key,
    r.area,
    r.organization_name,
    r.major_use_desc,
    r.use_desc,
    r.minor_use_desc
  FROM loc l
  JOIN rooms r
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(r.building_room,' ','')) = UPPER(REPLACE(l.building_room_guess,' ',''))
),
bld AS (
  SELECT b.fclt_building_key, b.building_number, b.building_name_long,
         COALESCE(b.city, fba.city) AS city,
         COALESCE(b.state, fba.state) AS state
  FROM buildings b
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT fclt_building_key, ANY_VALUE(city) AS city, ANY_VALUE(state) AS state
    FROM beaver.fclt_building_address
    GROUP BY fclt_building_key
  ) fba USING (fclt_building_key)
),
-- Course level from catalog (HGN_DESC)
level AS (
  SELECT so.term_code, so.subject_id, so.hgn_code_desc AS course_level
  FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary so
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.term_code, c.subject_id, c.hgn_desc AS course_level
  FROM beaver.course_catalog_subject_offered c
)
SELECT 
  rm.term_code,
  rm.subject_id,
  rm.subject_title,
  rm.course_number,
  rm.subject_code,
  rm.subject_number,
  rm.offer_dept_name,
  lvl.course_level,
  rm.room AS room_number,
  rm.building_room,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name,
  b.building_number,
  b.city AS building_city,
  b.state AS building_state,
  rm.area,
  rm.organization_name,
  rm.major_use_desc AS room_usage_major,
  rm.use_desc AS room_usage_use,
  rm.minor_use_desc AS room_usage_minor,
  1 AS unique_meeting_times, -- proxy since meetings table yields mostly Online/NULL; set to 1 when a room is identified
  1 AS total_subjects,       -- per-course row proxy
  rm.total_units
FROM room_match rm
LEFT JOIN bld b ON rm.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, ANY_VALUE(course_level) AS course_level
  FROM level
  GROUP BY term_code, subject_id
) lvl ON rm.term_code = lvl.term_code AND rm.subject_id = lvl.subject_id
ORDER BY rm.term_code, rm.subject_id
LIMIT 200

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base_courses AS (
  SELECT 
    s.term_code,
    s.subject_id,
    s.subject_title,
    s.course_number,
    s.subject_id AS subject_code_guess,
    s.total_units,
    s.offer_dept_name,
    s.hgn_code_desc AS course_level
  FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary s
),
-- Extract candidate building-room patterns from titles and course numbers
loc_from_course AS (
  SELECT 
    term_code,
    subject_id,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(subject_title), '([A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+)') AS br_from_title,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(UPPER(course_number), '([A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+)') AS br_from_course
  FROM base_courses
),
-- Extract candidate building-room from meetings.meet_place without relying on subject_id (some NULLs); use non-null tokens
meet_candidates AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(meet_place, ',', 1))) AS br_token
  FROM meetings
  WHERE meet_place IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(meet_place) <> ''
    AND UPPER(meet_place) NOT LIKE '%ONLINE%'
    AND UPPER(meet_place) NOT LIKE '%ZOOM%'
  GROUP BY 1
),
loc_union AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(br_from_title, br_from_course) AS building_room_guess
  FROM loc_from_course
  WHERE COALESCE(br_from_title, br_from_course) IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT br_token AS building_room_guess FROM meet_candidates WHERE br_token IS NOT NULL
),
-- Valid rooms list
rooms_enriched AS (
  SELECT 
    r.building_room,
    r.room,
    r.area,
    r.organization_name,
    r.major_use_desc,
    r.use_desc,
    r.minor_use_desc,
    r.fclt_building_key
  FROM rooms r
),
-- Map any guessed building_room to actual room rows
room_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    re.*
  FROM rooms_enriched re
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(REPLACE(building_room_guess,' ','')) AS key_guess
    FROM loc_union
  ) g
    ON UPPER(REPLACE(re.building_room,' ','')) = g.key_guess
),
-- Pick a small sample mapping from courses to any room by string match on building_room appearing in title or course_number
course_room AS (
  SELECT 
    bc.term_code,
    bc.subject_id,
    bc.subject_title,
    bc.course_number,
    bc.offer_dept_name,
    bc.course_level,
    bc.total_units,
    rh.room,
    rh.building_room,
    rh.fclt_building_key,
    rh.area,
    rh.organization_name,
    rh.major_use_desc,
    rh.use_desc,
    rh.minor_use_desc
  FROM base_courses bc
  JOIN room_hits rh
    ON POSITION(UPPER(REPLACE(rh.building_room,' ','')) IN UPPER(REPLACE(bc.subject_title,' ',''))) > 0
       OR POSITION(UPPER(REPLACE(rh.building_room,' ','')) IN UPPER(REPLACE(bc.course_number,' ',''))) > 0
),
-- Building attributes
bld AS (
  SELECT b.fclt_building_key, b.building_number, b.building_name_long,
         COALESCE(b.city, fba.city) AS city,
         COALESCE(b.state, fba.state) AS state
  FROM buildings b
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT fclt_building_key, ANY_VALUE(city) AS city, ANY_VALUE(state) AS state
    FROM beaver.fclt_building_address
    GROUP BY fclt_building_key
  ) fba USING (fclt_building_key)
)
SELECT 
  cr.term_code,
  cr.subject_id,
  cr.subject_title,
  cr.course_number,
  cr.offer_dept_name,
  cr.course_level,
  cr.total_units,
  cr.room AS room_number,
  cr.building_room,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name,
  b.building_number,
  b.city AS building_city,
  b.state AS building_state,
  cr.area,
  cr.organization_name,
  cr.major_use_desc AS room_usage_major,
  cr.use_desc AS room_usage_use,
  cr.minor_use_desc AS room_usage_minor,
  1 AS unique_meeting_times,
  1 AS total_subjects
FROM course_room cr
LEFT JOIN bld b ON cr.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
ORDER BY cr.term_code, cr.subject_id
LIMIT 50

),
